Character Creation — Part 1: Origins

Every Emberwold character starts with an Origin. Choose one of three: Cinderborn (fire-touched, +1 Ember die), Tidewrit (river-marked, reroll one failed Insight check per session), or Hollow (unmarked, +2 skill picks).

Roll 4d6 drop lowest for each of the four attributes: Vigor, Wit, Grace, Resolve. Continue to Part 2: Callings for class selection.
